METHOD-HP-BROKEN-STARTUP-PORTAL.rule: Track endpoint-level retrieval outcomes separately from scheme-level existence.

METHOD-HP-BUDGET-SUMMARY-NOT-OPERATIVE.rule: Keep existence/budget/intake evidence facets distinct across all state workbooks.

METHOD-HP-COMPONENTS-AS-SCHEMES-MOFPI-SM.rule: Require parent/component relationships and prevent component inflation in published counts.

METHOD-HP-CONFLICTING-CARP-TITLES.rule: Require document comparison before merging conflicting official titles.

METHOD-HP-CROSS-DEPARTMENT-ETAXI.rule: Represent multi-agency operational roles independently of the scheme owner.

METHOD-HP-DISTRICT-TARGET-FISHERIES.rule: Support geography-scoped intake and allocation evidence below a statewide scheme.

METHOD-HP-FAILED-ACCESS-NOT-VERIFIED-NON.rule: Make verified-none contingent on a successful official sweep and store endpoint failure evidence.

METHOD-HP-INSTITUTIONAL-FINANCE-SCST.rule: Add reusable owner/funder/channel/lender roles for institutional-finance schemes.

METHOD-HP-RENAMED-HIM-UNNATI-HIM-KRISHI.rule: Add alias/successor fields and name-effective dates for all jurisdictions.

METHOD-HP-SEASONAL-CALL-MOFPI-IRRADIATIO.rule: Model calls/windows as time-bounded children of durable schemes.

METHOD-HP-SERVICE-ENDPOINT-NOT-SCHEME.rule: Grade portal endpoints separately from operative scheme instruments.

METHOD-HP-STALE-OFFICIAL-HBCFDC.rule: Distinguish official provenance from temporal currency and require recency for hard claims.
